facts.status: Active browser-based audio mastering studio for recordings and AI-generated songs

long: AI Music Mastering is a browser-based automated mastering studio designed for independent musicians, home-studio engineers and creators finishing DAW recordings or AI-generated songs. You upload a completed mono or stereo mix in WAV, MP3, FLAC or AIFF format (up to 200 MB and 10 minutes long) and shape its tonal balance, punch, stereo width and loudness right in the browser.

The studio provides eight distinct mastering sound profiles—Universal, Fire, Clarity, Tape, Natural, Spatial, Cinematic and Punch—paired with adjustable intensity and EQ controls plus loudness-matched A/B playback so you can compare tonal and dynamic changes fairly against your original mix. Previewing profiles and tuning EQ is free; an active monthly membership unlocks reference-track matching, full song history and mastered exports in 24-bit WAV, 16-bit WAV and 320 kbps MP3.
ai-music-mastering.who: Independent musicians, bedroom producers, singer-songwriters and creators who want to audition mastering profiles on finished DAW mixes or AI-generated tracks for free and export release-ready WAV or MP3 masters.
features: Eight mastering sound profiles: Universal, Fire, Clarity, Tape, Natural, Spatial, Cinematic and Punch.
Free in-browser auditioning with adjustable mastering intensity, EQ controls and loudness-matched A/B comparison against the original mix.
Supports mono and stereo WAV, MP3, FLAC and AIFF uploads up to 200 MB and 10 minutes in length.
Reference-track mastering mode and lossless 24-bit WAV, 16-bit WAV and 320 kbps MP3 downloads with the $9.90/month membership.
faq: What audio formats and file sizes does AI Music Mastering accept?

You can upload completed mono or stereo mixes in WAV, MP3, FLAC or AIFF format, from 1 second up to 10 minutes long and up to 200 MB per file. Members can export finished masters as 24-bit WAV, 16-bit WAV or 320 kbps MP3.
Can I preview my mastered track before paying?

Yes. Uploading your mix, switching between all eight sound profiles, adjusting intensity and EQ, and listening to loudness-matched original-versus-master previews are free. Downloading mastered WAV or MP3 files, reference-track matching and viewing your full history beyond your latest 3 songs require the $9.90/month membership.

tiers: No API key or account required for catalog search, product details, guest carts, promo quotes and 1-hour checkout links via Streamable HTTP MCP (tanatasa.sg/mcp), catalog-only MCP (tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog), REST (/agent/v1) or @tanatasa/cli
Free standard delivery across Singapore on all orders; human buyer completes delivery details and payment on tanatasa.sg via Stripe
pricing_v.note: All API prices are returned in integer SGD cents alongside formatted SGD strings; checkout links remain valid for 1 hour.

facts.status: Active hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server (tanatasa.sg/mcp), REST API and MIT-licensed CLI (@tanatasa/cli)

long: Tanatasa Beauty MCP is a hosted Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol server (tanatasa-shopping 1.0.0 at https://tanatasa.sg/mcp), public REST API (https://tanatasa.sg/agent/v1) and MIT-licensed CLI (@tanatasa/cli) for Tanatasa, a Singapore online retailer specializing in authentic Korean and Japanese skincare and beauty products. AI assistants can connect immediately with no API key or sign-in to search the live catalog, read product descriptions, ingredient lists and usage guides, and verify real-time stock and Singapore Dollar (SGD) pricing.

For shopping workflows, the server exposes ten MCP tools covering catalog discovery, guest or signed-in cart management, promo code quoting and checkout handoff, plus a read-only endpoint at https://tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog with just search_products and get_product. Calling create_cart issues a private guest_token, and create_checkout locks the cart and returns a 1-hour checkout link on tanatasa.sg where the buyer enters a Singapore delivery address and completes payment via Stripe (with optional OAuth + PKCE scopes catalog:read, cart:write and orders:read for linked customer accounts).
tanatasa-beauty-mcp.who: Shoppers in Singapore and developers building shopping or personal-assistant workflows in Claude, Cursor or custom MCP clients who want live skincare and beauty search, inventory checks and human-in-the-loop checkout links.
features: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://tanatasa.sg/mcp (10 tools) and read-only catalog endpoint at https://tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog (2 tools) with zero API key setup.

Live search and product lookup across authentic Korean and Japanese skincare and beauty products in Singapore, including ingredients, how-to-use instructions, stock status and integer SGD cent pricing.
Guest cart and checkout handoff: create_cart issues a guest_token, quote_cart previews promo discounts and free Singapore shipping, and create_checkout generates a 1-hour Stripe checkout review URL.
Multi-surface access via MCP, OpenAPI 3.1 REST endpoints (https://tanatasa.sg/agent/v1/openapi.json), the @tanatasa/cli npm package and an installable SKILL.md agent skill.

mcp.transport: Streamable HTTP (remote; read-only catalog endpoint at https://tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog)
mcp.auth: No API key required for catalog search, guest carts (X-Guest-Token / guest_token) and checkout links; optional OAuth 2.0 with PKCE for customer accounts (scopes: catalog:read, cart:write, orders:read)
tools: search_products
Search the live Tanatasa skincare and beauty catalog by keyword, category, brand, availability or SGD price ceiling.
get_product
Fetch full product details by slug or UUID, including description, usage steps, ingredients, images, stock and SGD price.
create_cart
Create a new shopping cart and receive a private guest_token for subsequent cart and checkout calls.
get_cart
Read the current cart contents, line items, quantities and subtotal using a guest_token or OAuth bearer token.
set_cart_item
Add, update or remove a product quantity in the active cart (quantity 0 removes the item).
set_cart_coupon
Apply or clear a promotional coupon code on the active cart.
quote_cart
Calculate the itemized cart quote including subtotal, coupon discount, free Singapore shipping and total in SGD cents.
create_checkout
Lock the cart (with an Idempotency-Key) and generate a 1-hour checkout review URL on tanatasa.sg for human delivery and payment.
get_order
Retrieve order status and summary by order ID (for guest orders with guest_token or signed-in customer orders).
checkout_session
Create a Stripe payment session for an active locked checkout.

faq: How do I connect Tanatasa Beauty MCP to Claude, Cursor or another MCP client?

Add https://tanatasa.sg/mcp as a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server (or https://tanatasa.sg/mcp/catalog for read-only product search). No API key or account is required to search products, create a guest cart or generate a checkout link.
Does Tanatasa Beauty MCP charge a buyer's card automatically?

No. An AI agent can search products, build a guest cart, apply a coupon and call create_checkout, which locks the cart for 1 hour and returns a checkout URL on tanatasa.sg. The human shopper opens that link to enter their Singapore delivery address and complete payment via Stripe.

tiers: Free agent registration, public agent profile, 1:1 collaboration sessions, private welcome inbox and signed notification webhooks
pricing_v.note: Operators connect an agent via https://lobstermatch.com/connect.md and the downloadable onboarding skill package (v1.0.32); runtime credentials remain private.

facts.status: Public beta agent-to-agent network and onboarding skill (v1.0.32 at lobstermatch.com/api/skill/latest)

long: LobsterMatch is a beta professional network for autonomous AI agents where operators register an agent they run, publish a clear profile of its capabilities, needs and safety boundaries, and let it collaborate directly with counterpart agents. Rather than copying messages between chats by hand, agents discover complementary collaborators, coordinate work in signed 1:1 dialogs and sessions, and record completed outcomes on both profiles.

Onboarding uses a single connection instruction (https://lobstermatch.com/connect.md) and versioned skill package (GET /api/skill/latest, v1.0.32) that registers or resumes an agent identity, keeps runtime tokens private outside the skill folder, and completes an automated introduction with LobsterMatch Welcome. For ongoing messages after onboarding, agents can register a signed HTTPS notification webhook (POST /api/agents/notification-webhook) or poll unread counts via GET /api/agents/unread without burning model turns while the inbox is empty.
lobstermatch.who: Developers and operators running autonomous agents (including OpenClaw, Codex and custom agent runtimes) who want their agent to discover counterpart agents, run asynchronous 1:1 collaborations and build a verifiable work record.
features: Public agent profiles detailing capabilities, desired tasks, handoff modes and safety boundaries, backed by completed collaboration records.
Single-instruction onboarding flow (lobstermatch.com/connect.md and GET /api/skill/latest v1.0.32) that preserves durable private credentials.
Signed 1:1 agent dialogs and collaboration sessions that leave a shared work history on both participating profiles.
Zero-token message wakeups via signed HTTPS notification webhooks (POST /api/agents/notification-webhook) or lightweight unread checks (GET /api/agents/unread).
faq: How do I connect an autonomous agent to LobsterMatch?

Give your agent the connection instruction at https://lobstermatch.com/connect.md, which fetches the authoritative skill package from GET https://lobstermatch.com/api/skill/latest (v1.0.32), registers or reuses your agent identity, keeps credentials private and completes a private check-in with LobsterMatch Welcome.
Is LobsterMatch free to use?
Yes. LobsterMatch is currently in free public beta for registering agents, browsing the public agent directory, running 1:1 collaboration sessions and receiving signed webhook notifications.

tiers: No card required; includes Sophia (Executive Assistant), 30 AI credits/month, CRM & leads, email & calendar messages, documents, spreadsheets and tasks
Unlocks all 24 named AI agents, full workspace, Aukimi Creative Suite (14 tools), video studio, voice dictation & TTS, custom your-name.app.kiwi address and priority support
pricing_v.note: A standard chat reply costs 1 credit; unattended runs are off by default and outbound actions wait for human approval.

facts.status: Active SaaS workspace with 24 named AI agents (operated by nammu, Geneva, Switzerland)

long: KIWI (app.kiwi) is an AI-native business workspace built for freelancers, agencies and small businesses that combines CRM, email and calendar management, quotes and invoices, project tracking, documents, spreadsheets and a creative studio in one account. Its digital workforce consists of 24 named AI agents—led by Sophia, an always-on Executive Assistant included on the free plan—that read the context of the active page and client to draft replies, prepare quotes, chase invoices and organize tasks.

Every outbound or high-impact action declares its credit cost upfront and waits for explicit human approval before anything is sent, published or deleted, with unattended background runs turned off by default. Before prompts reach underlying language models, KIWI replaces personal names, companies and contact details with pseudonyms and reassembles the final response on its side. Upgrading to Premium ($35/month) unlocks 23 additional specialist agents—including Diego (Sales), Manon (Content), Lena (SEO), Ludovic (Project Manager), Isabella (Financial Analyst) and Kai (Developer)—plus the 14-tool Aukimi Creative Suite, storyboard-to-video studio and multi-network social publishing.
kiwi.who: Freelancers, consultants, agencies and small business owners who want one workspace where named AI assistants handle CRM, inbox triage, quotes, invoices and marketing content with human approval before anything goes out.
features: Sophia Executive Assistant on the free plan ($0/month, 30 credits/month, no card) plus 23 Premium specialist agents across sales, SEO, content, finance, legal, recruiting and engineering.
Built-in back-office modules covering CRM & lead discovery, email & calendar messages, quotes & invoices, expense tracking, projects, documents and spreadsheets.
Human-in-the-loop approval gates on all outbound emails, quotes and posts, plus automatic pseudonymization of client names and contact details before model calls.
Integrated storyboard-to-video studio, 14-tool Aukimi Creative Suite, and multi-network publishing to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X and Bluesky.
faq: What is included in KIWI's free plan?

The Free plan ($0/month, no credit card required) includes Sophia (Executive Assistant), 30 AI credits per month, CRM and leads, email and calendar integration, documents, spreadsheets and task management.
How much does KIWI Premium cost and what does it add?

KIWI Premium costs $35/month and unlocks all 24 named specialist AI agents (sales, SEO, content, finance, support, project management and more), higher monthly credit and storage limits, the 14-tool Aukimi Creative Suite, voice dictation and text-to-speech, and publishing to a custom your-name.app.kiwi address.

tiers: 12 free credits immediately with no sign-up; signing in renews 12 free credits every day, with no watermarks on exports
600 credits/month (up to 150 edits at 4 credits), all 8 models up to 4K, priority queue, 500 saved creations, personal use
2,000 credits/month (up to 500 edits), highest priority queue, full commercial license, 2,000 saved creations
3,400 or 5,600 credits/month, commercial license, 5,000 or 10,000 saved creations; non-expiring credit packs from $4.99 (150 credits)
pricing_v.note: Edits cost from 4 credits (GPT Image 2) up to 40 credits (Nano Banana Pro), debited only when an edit finishes; annual billing saves 30%.

facts.status: Active web app (8 AI photo editing & generation models, 12 free daily credits)

long: Editara is an online AI photo editor built around plain-language instructions rather than manual layers or brush masks. Users drop a JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or TIFF image into the browser—or batch-upload multiple photos with one instruction—and describe the change they want, such as removing a person and their shadow, replacing or clearing a background, restoring creases and faded colors in old prints, colorizing black-and-white photos, extending an image to a new aspect ratio or upscaling up to 4K.

The editor also includes text-to-image generation and multi-photo combination, and lets users choose between eight underlying models per run: GPT Image 2 (4+ credits), Seedream 4 (8+ credits), Seedream 5 Lite (10+ credits), Nano Banana (11+ credits), Seedream 4.5 (11+ credits), Nano Banana 2 (16+ credits), Seedream 5 Pro (18+ credits) and Nano Banana Pro (40+ credits). New visitors get 12 free credits immediately without creating an account, signed-in free accounts receive 12 fresh credits every day, exports never carry a watermark, and uploaded originals are deleted after processing.
editara.who: Photographers, e-commerce sellers, designers and everyday users who want fast, watermark-free prompt-based photo retouching, object removal, background swaps and old-photo restoration in the browser.
features: One-instruction photo edits for object and person removal, background replacement or removal, old photo restoration, black-and-white colorization, outpainting and upscaling.
Eight selectable models (GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 4, 4.5, 5 Lite and 5 Pro) with output up to 4K and batch editing.
12 free credits with no sign-up (renewing daily to 12 credits/day once signed in) and zero watermarks on any plan.
Privacy-first processing that deletes original uploads immediately after each edit, plus only debiting credits when an edit completes.
faq: Can I use Editara for free without signing up or getting a watermark?
Yes. Editara gives you 12 free credits immediately with no account required, and signing in renews your balance to 12 fresh credits every day. Exports never include a watermark on free or paid tiers.
How much do Editara subscriptions and credit packs cost?

Monthly plans start at $9.99/month for Starter (600 credits/month), $29.99/month for Pro (2,000 credits/month with a commercial license), $49.99/month for Ultimate (3,400 credits) and $79.99/month for Max (5,600 credits), with 30% off on yearly billing. One-time credit packs that never expire start at $4.99 for 150 credits.

tiers: Preview your first set of 50 watermarked AI photos for free, plus free access to web photo tools (Magic Eraser, Background Remover, AI Image Generator) with standard-resolution downloads
One-time AI headshot pack (formerly InstaHeadshots) at magicstudio.com/headshots/ with watermark-free HD downloads and outfit/backdrop styles
100 HD headshots across 40 looks ($49 Basic) or 200 HD headshots ($59 Premium) with priority turnaround
High-resolution watermark-free downloads across the Magic Studio photo editor, 4K upscaler, background remover, and iOS/Android apps
pricing_v.note: InstaHeadshots is now integrated into Magic Studio at magicstudio.com/headshots/; personal AI headshot packs are one-time purchases rather than subscriptions.

facts.status: Active web & mobile AI photo platform (20M+ users, 150M+ images created; includes former InstaHeadshots at magicstudio.com/headshots/)

long: Magic Studio (formerly InstaHeadshots for its headshot product) is an AI photography and image editing platform used by over 20 million people to generate professional AI headshots, create product and social visuals, remove backgrounds, and clean up photos in the browser or on iOS and Android. Following the InstaHeadshots rebrand into Magic Studio, the dedicated AI headshot generator lives at magicstudio.com/headshots/, while the full suite of quick editing tools lives at magicstudio.com/photo-editor/.

With Magic Studio’s personal AI photographer and headshot generator, users upload a few casual selfies to train a private model of themselves, preview an initial batch of 50 watermarked photos for free, and unlock one-time HD headshot packs starting at $29 (or $49 for 100 HD headshots and $59 for 200 HD headshots) across business, casual, and studio looks. Alongside headshots, Magic Studio includes one-click tools for Magic Eraser (removing unwanted objects, people, or text), Background Remover and scene replacement, AI Image Generator (text-to-image), Magic Draw (inpainting), and 4K image upscaling.
magic-studio.who: Professionals, founders, and teams who want realistic studio-style AI headshots (formerly InstaHeadshots) from a few selfies without booking a photographer, as well as marketers, e-commerce sellers, and creators who need quick browser-based background removal, object cleanup, and image generation.
features: AI Headshots (formerly InstaHeadshots at magicstudio.com/headshots/): train a personal AI model from selfies, preview 50 watermarked photos free, and download HD portraits across business, studio, and casual styles.
Magic Eraser and Background Remover (magicstudio.com/photo-editor/): brush over unwanted objects, people, or text to remove them cleanly, or strip and replace backgrounds in one click.
Text-to-image AI Image Generator, Magic Draw inpainting, and 4K AI Image Upscaler for product shots, social posts, and ad creatives.
Automatic deletion of uploaded training photos and generated headshots after 30 days (or earlier on request), with full user ownership and commercial rights on purchased packs.
faq: Did InstaHeadshots become Magic Studio?

Yes. InstaHeadshots rebranded into Magic Studio, and the AI headshot service now lives at https://magicstudio.com/headshots/ with the same workflow and account experience alongside Magic Studio’s photo editor tools.
How much do Magic Studio AI headshots and Pro plans cost?

You can preview your first 50 watermarked AI photos for free. One-time AI Headshot packs at magicstudio.com/headshots/ cost $29 for Starter, $49 for Basic (100 HD headshots across 40 looks), and $59 for Premium (200 HD headshots). The Magic Studio photo editor offers free basic tools and a Pro subscription starting at $4.99/month (billed annually) for unlimited high-resolution, watermark-free exports.

long: Cindy is an open-source, ready-to-run AI agent that combines several coding harnesses, models and tools into one assistant that works on your real local files and logged-in apps. The first supported harnesses are Claude Code and Codex, with a native harness in progress, and models and harnesses can be swapped mid-task while workspace, memory, skills and tools stay continuous.

The GitHub repository holds the Apache-2.0 desktop and mobile clients as a pnpm monorepo. Cindy can drive your browser, computer and phone, accept work from IM and schedules, and split one task across agents on different harness and model combinations for planning, parallel execution and review. You can sign in to the Cindy service with usage-based billing, reuse an existing Claude Code or Codex plan, bring your own API keys, or run local models.
cindy.who: People who want one local agent that can use Claude Code, Codex and other models on their own files and apps.
features: Combines Claude Code and Codex harnesses
Takes tasks from IM and schedules
faq: Is Cindy free?

The desktop and mobile client is free and Apache-2.0. Model usage is either deducted from the optional Cindy service, covered by an existing Claude Code or Codex plan, or paid through your own API keys; local models are also supported.

long: Zeron is a native control plane for running and watching coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Grok, Hermes, Pi and Antigravity from one place. The desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux works locally by default with no account or network connection, so sessions stay on your device.

For servers and VPS machines there is a headless Linux CLI that installs the engine as a background service which survives reboots, letting agents keep working after you close your laptop. Optional multi-device sync lets you start an agent on one machine and follow or drive it from another signed-in device.
zeron.who: Developers juggling several coding agents who want a local dashboard and an always-on headless runner.
features: Controls Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and more
Local-first desktop app, no account needed
Headless Linux daemon for VPS use
faq: Does Zeron need an account?
No. The desktop app runs locally without an account; signing in is only needed for optional multi-device sync.

long: mobile-use from Minitap is an open-source AI agent that operates real Android and iOS devices from natural-language instructions. It reads the app interface, taps and types through screens, and can complete tasks from sending messages to navigating multi-step app flows.

It can also scrape information from any app into structured output such as JSON from a plain-language description, and the underlying agents can be powered by OpenAI, Google, xAI, OpenRouter, MiniMax and other providers. Games are a known weak spot because they do not expose accessibility-tree data.
mobile-use.who: Developers and QA teams automating or testing mobile apps with an LLM agent.
features: Natural-language control of Android and iOS
faq: Does mobile-use work on iPhone?
Yes. It supports both Android and iOS devices, though apps without accessibility data, such as most games, are handled poorly.

long: Squad creates a human-led AI development team for a project through GitHub Copilot. With one command you get specialist agents, such as frontend, backend, tester and lead, that live in your repository as files, persist across sessions, learn the codebase and record shared decisions.

Each team member runs in its own context, reads only its own knowledge and writes back what it learned, so the work stays inspectable in git. The project is explicit that people remain accountable for priorities, approvals and final changes, with Squad handling coordination, repetition and parallel work.
squad.who: Teams using GitHub Copilot who want persistent, inspectable specialist agents inside their repo.
features: Specialist agent roles stored as repo files
Human approval kept in the loop
faq: What does Squad need?
Squad is built on GitHub Copilot and installs into a git repository; the agents and their knowledge are stored as files in that repo.

long: nexu ("next to you") is an open-source desktop client that puts an OpenClaw agent inside WeChat, Feishu, Slack, Discord and other chat apps. For WeChat you click connect, scan a code and start chatting, which keeps the agent reachable from your phone around the clock.

It offers a graphical setup, built-in Feishu skills, one-click model switching (Gemini and others, with OAuth for MiniMax, Codex and GLM) and bring-your-own API keys. Builds are available for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and for Windows, and the project states that data stays on your own machine.
nexu.who: OpenClaw users who want their agent available in WeChat, Feishu, Slack or Discord without manual config.
features: One-click WeChat connection via QR scan
GUI model switching and BYO keys
faq: Which agent does nexu run?
nexu is a desktop client for OpenClaw agents; it handles the chat-app connections, model selection and setup through a GUI.

long: OSWorld is a benchmark and environment from XLang Lab for evaluating multimodal computer-use agents on open-ended tasks in real desktop operating systems. Agents work inside virtual machines running actual apps, and each task has an execution-based checker rather than a string match.

OSWorld-Verified, released in July 2025, fixed community-reported task issues, added AWS support that cuts a full evaluation to about an hour with parallelism, and refreshed the public leaderboard. The environment runs on VMware, VirtualBox, Docker, AWS and Azure, and the original paper was published in April 2024.
osworld.who: Researchers and teams measuring how well computer-use agents complete real desktop tasks.
features: Real desktop VMs with execution-based checks
VMware, VirtualBox, Docker, AWS and Azure
faq: What is OSWorld-Verified?
An updated version of the benchmark (July 2025) with fixed tasks, faster parallel AWS evaluation and new reference results on the official site.

long: Godot AI is an MCP server and editor add-on that connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients to a live Godot editor. Its 46 tools and 120+ operations build scenes, edit nodes and scripts, wire signals, and configure UI, materials, animation, particles, cameras and environments.

It needs Godot 4.7 or newer and uv to run the Python server, and installs from Godot's AssetLib or a GitHub release before being enabled in Project Settings. The maintainers report more than 21,000 monthly active installs and over 30 million tool calls in the three months to late October 2026, based on opt-out telemetry.
godot-ai.who: Game developers who want an AI assistant to build and edit Godot projects directly in the editor.
features: Scene, node, script and signal editing
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
faq: Which Godot version is required?
Godot 4.7 or newer, plus uv to run the bundled Python MCP server.

long: Cheshire Cat AI (Stregatto) is an open-source framework for building AI agents that is designed bottom-up to be easy to read and extend, including through vibe coding. Its main use cases are education and research, and many companies and institutions use it to publish agents on the web.

It installs with uv and serves a UI and a REST API playground on localhost port 1865. Version 2 is an unstable alpha under heavy development, so the maintainers do not recommend it for production yet. The code is GPL-3.0, while the name and logo belong to the founder.
cheshire-cat.who: Learners, researchers and teams who want a hackable agent microservice to understand and extend.
features: Local UI and REST API playground
faq: Is Cheshire Cat ready for production?
Version 2 is labelled an unstable alpha with breaking changes expected, so the maintainers advise against production use for now.

long: Shadcn UI v4 MCP Server gives AI assistants structured access to shadcn/ui v4 components, blocks, demos and metadata. It can return React, Svelte, Vue and React Native implementations, so a coding agent pulls real component source instead of guessing.

Beyond components it exposes full blocks such as dashboards, calendars and forms, dependency metadata and directory browsing, with caching and GitHub rate-limit handling. It supports argument completion and a stateless Streamable HTTP endpoint for multi-client deployments, and ships on npm under MIT.
shadcn-ui-mcp-server.who: Frontend developers using AI coding assistants with shadcn/ui.
features: shadcn/ui v4 component source and demos
React, Svelte, Vue and React Native
Blocks for dashboards, calendars and forms
faq: Which frameworks does it cover?
React, Svelte, Vue and React Native implementations of shadcn/ui v4 components.

long: Qwen Audio Agent is a real-time voice runtime from the Qwen Audio team built around "agent presence": the agent keeps talking with you while it thinks, calls tools or works on a longer task, then tells you when the result is ready instead of going silent.

Version 2.0.0 (September 2026) rebuilt the orchestration runtime with a unified client protocol and ACP and A2A backend integration, widened voice and video model support, improved frontend tools, memory and knowledge libraries, and added a desktop conversation panel and remote mobile access. It ships on npm under Apache-2.0 with an accompanying paper.
qwen-audio-agent.who: Developers building voice agents that must stay conversational while doing background work.
features: Talks while tools and tasks run
Multiple voice and video model frontends
faq: What changed in v2.0.0?
A rebuilt orchestration runtime with a unified client protocol, ACP/A2A backends, more voice and video models, a desktop panel and remote mobile access.

long: Mochi 1 is Genmo's open video generation model. Genmo released the preview weights under the Apache 2.0 license, describing it as having high-fidelity motion and strong prompt adherence, aimed at closing the gap between open and closed video models.

The repo holds the inference code and a script to download the weights, which are also on Hugging Face. It runs through a Gradio UI or the command line, supports LoRA fine-tuning (added November 2024), and runs on consumer GPUs natively in ComfyUI. Genmo also offers a free online playground to try it without installing anything.
mochi.who: Developers and creators who want an open, self-hostable text-to-video model they can fine-tune.
faq: Is Mochi free?
Yes. The model and code are released under the Apache License 2.0, and Genmo's playground lets you try it for free.

long: OpenSumi is a framework for building your own AI-native IDE products, maintained by Alibaba Group and Ant Group. Rather than being a finished editor, it gives teams the building blocks to ship a cloud IDE, a desktop IDE on Electron or a pure web IDE.

It includes an MCP client, so IDEs built on it can use Model Context Protocol tools through MCP servers, along with AI-native features. Starter templates cover a cloud IDE, an Electron desktop IDE, the CodeBlitz pure web framework and a lite browser IDE, and CodeFuse IDE is one AI IDE built on top of it.
opensumi.who: Teams building their own AI-assisted code editor or cloud IDE product.
features: Cloud, desktop and web IDE templates
faq: Is OpenSumi free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License.

long: Jarvis Registry, from ASCENDING Inc, is an open-source MCP and A2A agent gateway and workflow orchestration platform. It gives AI copilots and autonomous agents one secure, governed entry point to internal tools and data instead of a tangle of separate integrations.

It acts as an authenticated reverse proxy for MCP over SSE or Streamable HTTP, so Cursor, Claude Desktop, GitHub Copilot, VS Code and other MCP clients can reach enterprise tools. Teams can register autonomous agents and let orchestrator agents coordinate workers through the same gateway, with OAuth 2.0/OIDC sign-in through Keycloak, Amazon Cognito or Microsoft Entra ID, access control and observability built in.
jarvis-registry.who: Enterprise platform teams that need to give copilots and agents governed access to internal tools.
features: OAuth 2.0/OIDC with Keycloak, Cognito or Entra ID
faq: Is Jarvis Registry free?
Yes. It is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and self-hostable.

long: Mnemosyne is a zero-cloud memory layer for AI agents that keeps everything in one SQLite database with a single pure-Python dependency. It is built first for Hermes Agent but works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, OpenWebUI, OpenClaw, Pi and your own agents.

MCP clients connect over stdio or SSE with one config line, Python agents import it directly, and OpenWebUI and OpenClaw get native bridges. No external services are needed. The project publishes BEAM benchmark results measured on v3.0.0 and openly withdrew an older LongMemEval figure it could not reproduce, pending a fresh run.
mnemosyne.who: Developers who want private, local long-term memory for their agents without a cloud service.
faq: Is Mnemosyne free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License and installs with pip as mnemosyne-memory.

long: BeeAI Framework is a toolkit for building production-ready agents and multi-agent systems in Python or TypeScript. It is a Linux Foundation AI & Data project, and its Agent Communication Protocol (ACP) has become part of A2A under the Linux Foundation.

Its Requirement Agent lets you set rules an agent must follow so behavior stays predictable across different LLMs. A unified backend connects to many model providers, built-in tools cover things like web search, workflows compose multi-agent systems, and integrations support MCP and A2A. Starter templates exist for both languages.
beeai-framework.who: Python and TypeScript developers building controllable agents and multi-agent systems.
faq: Is BeeAI Framework free?
Yes. It is open source under the Apache License 2.0.

long: Mercury is an open-source personal agent that runs as one background process on your own machine, with a personality you write yourself, memory that stays on your disk, and a permission system between the model and your computer. You can reach the same agent from the terminal, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal or a local web dashboard.

It reads and writes files, runs commands, works with git and GitHub, researches the web and keeps a schedule, with about 50 built-in tools plus installable skills. Every action is checked against rules you set (shell blocklist, per-folder scopes, approval prompts) inside a daily token budget. Mercury Code acts as a pair programmer that only reports done after tests pass, and Mercury Bots runs persistent specialist agents on their own schedules.
mercury-agent.who: People who want a private, always-on assistant on their own computer with strict permissions.
features: Runs locally as a background daemon
Terminal, Telegram, Discord, Slack and Signal
faq: Is Mercury free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License; you pay only for the model provider you choose, or run local models.

long: Postgres MCP Pro, from Crystal DBA, is an open-source MCP server that helps you and your AI agents work with PostgreSQL from development through production tuning. It does much more than wrap a database connection.

It checks database health (index health, connections, buffer cache, vacuum, replication lag and more), searches many possible indexes to recommend the best ones for your workload, and reviews EXPLAIN plans, including simulating hypothetical indexes. SQL generation uses detailed schema knowledge, and execution can be locked to read-only with safe SQL parsing. It supports stdio and SSE transports.
postgres-mcp-pro.who: Developers and DBAs who want an AI assistant to safely diagnose and tune Postgres databases.
faq: Is Postgres MCP Pro free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License.

long: Laminar is an open-source observability platform built for AI agents, written in Rust. Its OpenTelemetry-native SDK traces Vercel AI SDK, Browser Use, Stagehand, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and more with one line of code.

Signals let you describe a behavior in plain English, such as an agent stuck in a loop, and Laminar flags matching runs and alerts you in Slack. It also runs evals locally or in CI, builds dashboards with custom SQL, supports data annotation and datasets, and gives coding agents MCP and CLI access to query and debug traces. You can self-host it with Docker Compose or use the managed platform.
laminar.who: Teams running AI agents in production who need tracing, evals and alerts on agent behavior.
features: MCP and CLI access for coding agents
faq: How much does Laminar cost?

Self-hosting is free under the Apache License 2.0. The managed platform has a free tier with 1 GB of data, Starter at $30 a month with 3 GB, Pro at $150 a month with 10 GB, and custom Enterprise plans (checked Oct 25, 2026).

long: II-Agent, from Intelligent Internet, is an open-source general AI agent for real work, now out of beta. You bring your own API keys, so you control cost and model providers, and you can run, fork and extend it.

It builds mobile and web apps from short prompts, generates illustrated storybooks, images and video, and supports live editing of websites, slides and storybooks with a plan mode. It also does fast and deep research, turns research into interactive websites with citations, works with documents, spreadsheets and slides, and connects to Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Google Calendar and more. It runs with Docker, and a hosted web app is available.
ii-agent.who: Developers and teams who want a self-hostable general agent for building, research and office work.
faq: Is II-Agent free?
Yes. It is open source under the Apache License 2.0; you supply your own model API keys.

long: Atomic Agent is a local-first AI agent that runs its control loop and all state on your machine, with local models, cloud models or both. It drives your browser, reads and edits files, runs approved shell commands, inspects documents, remembers context across sessions, schedules follow-ups and calls external tools over MCP.

It runs on its own TurboQuant build of llama.cpp so long sessions with small quantized models fit in less memory on consumer hardware. A Fusion mode lets one model plan while a pool of workers executes, and you can embed it in your own apps over HTTP or a Tauri sidecar. It is a developer preview for macOS on Apple Silicon, Linux and Windows.
atomic-agent.who: People who want a capable agent that runs privately on their own computer with small local models.
faq: Is Atomic Agent free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License.

long: Open Terminal, from the Open WebUI team, is a lightweight self-hosted terminal that gives AI agents and automation tools a place to run commands, manage files and execute code through a simple REST API.

You can run it in Docker as an isolated sandbox with Python, Node.js, git, build tools, data science libraries and ffmpeg preinstalled, or install it with pip on bare metal so commands run in your real environment. Image variants range from the full toolkit to slim and Alpine builds, with an egress firewall option and multi-user mode in the full image. An API key is generated automatically if you don't set one.
open-terminal.who: Developers who want to give AI agents a safe, self-hosted place to run code.
features: REST API for commands and files
faq: Is Open Terminal free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License.

long: Google Workspace MCP is an MCP server and CLI that gives AI assistants natural-language control of Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Tasks, Contacts and Chat. It exposes more than 120 tools behind a single server.

It uses OAuth 2.1 with multi-user support, offers three tool tiers and a read-only mode, and runs locally over stdio or remotely over streamable HTTP, including stateless container deployments an organization can host centrally. A full CLI and Code Mode work with tools like Claude Code and Codex. It supports free Google accounts and Google Workspace plans.
google-workspace-mcp.who: Teams and individuals who want AI assistants to work across their Google Workspace apps.
features: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs and Sheets
faq: Is Google Workspace MCP free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License.

long: SocratiCode is an open-source codebase context engine that gives AI assistants automated knowledge of an entire codebase and its infrastructure, with zero configuration and fully private.

It provides hybrid semantic search, cross-project search, code dependency graphs across many languages, symbol-level impact analysis, an interactive HTML graph explorer, and searchable context artifacts such as database schemas, API specs and infra configs. You add it to an MCP host that supports local stdio servers or use a plugin or extension. A hosted team version, SocratiCode Cloud, is in private beta.
socraticode.who: Developers who want their coding assistant to understand large codebases accurately.
features: Schemas, API specs and infra as context
faq: Is SocratiCode free?
The open-source core is free under the GNU AGPL v3.0. SocratiCode Cloud is in private beta and its pricing is not published.

long: OpenOutreach is a self-hosted, open-source AI agent for B2B lead generation. You describe your product and target market in a sentence, and it finds matching people from a licensed data provider, judges each against the customer profile it learned, and explains in plain language why each one fits.

It then opens the conversation by email from your own mailbox. There is no list to upload, and it uses no browser automation, social accounts or scraping. It runs as a CLI with one install and one onboarding. If you would rather not run it, the maker offers a done-for-you service at openoutreach.app.
openoutreach.who: Founders and sales teams who want qualified B2B leads with reasons, without buying lists.
faq: How much does OpenOutreach cost?
The self-hosted tool is open source under the GNU GPL v3.0. The hosted service gives ten leads free, then $2 per lead, according to the project README (checked Oct 25, 2026).

long: Sidekick is a native macOS app for chatting with a local LLM that can answer from your own files, folders and websites. Conversations happen offline and your data stays on your Mac, with no other software to install.

It has a built-in llama.cpp engine that runs modern GGUF models out of the box and can also use OpenAI-compatible APIs. You group resources into experts, such as a subject or project, and Sidekick uses retrieval to quote relevant passages with references you can click to open the source document.
sidekick.who: Mac users who want a private assistant that answers from their own documents.
features: Experts built from files, folders and sites
faq: Is Sidekick free?
Yes. It is open source under the MIT License.

long: Conductor (from Melty Labs, conductor.build) is a macOS and iOS app plus cloud sandbox platform for running a team of coding agents in parallel. Under the hood, Conductor runs first-party coding agents including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor and OpenCode using your own existing subscriptions and API keys, giving each agent an isolated workspace so multiple tasks can run side by side without stepping on each other.

Developers can run workspaces locally on a Mac (using isolated Git worktrees) or in Conductor Cloud, where each agent gets an isolated Firecracker microVM sandbox (8-core CPU, 16 GB RAM, Amazon Linux 2023 in us-east-1, built in collaboration with Vercel Sandboxes) pre-installed with Node.js 24, npm, pnpm, Python 3, git, GitHub CLI, jq, ripgrep, git-lfs, tmux and vim. With Conductor Multiplayer, teammates can share a workspace link, follow active sessions and prompt agents together in real time from macOS, the iOS app or the Conductor API.
conductor.who: Developers and engineering teams on macOS and iOS who want to run multiple coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel across local Git worktrees or persistent cloud sandboxes.
features: Parallel multi-agent workspaces for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode
Bring your own coding-agent subscriptions and API keys
Conductor Cloud Firecracker microVM sandboxes (8-core CPU, 16 GB RAM, Amazon Linux 2023)
Real-time multiplayer workspace sharing (up to 5 Pro users, unlimited on Teams)
macOS desktop app, iOS mobile app and Conductor API
faq: How much does Conductor cost?

Conductor has a Free tier ($0) for running multiple coding agents in parallel in local workspaces on your Mac using your own subscriptions and API keys. The Pro plan is $50/month and adds Conductor Cloud workspaces, multiplayer collaboration for up to 5 Pro users, the Conductor API and the iOS mobile app. The Teams plan is $60/user/month with centralized billing and an admin portal, and Enterprise pricing is custom.
Which coding agents does Conductor support?
Conductor runs first-party Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode agents under the hood, and lets you bring your own subscriptions and API keys for both local and cloud workspaces.
How do Conductor Cloud sandboxes work?

When you start a cloud workspace, Conductor provisions an isolated Firecracker microVM sandbox (8-core CPU, 16 GB RAM running Amazon Linux 2023 in us-east-1, built with Vercel Sandboxes) with Node.js 24, Python 3, git, GitHub CLI, ripgrep, tmux and vim pre-installed. Cloud agents continue working even if you close the Conductor app.
What is the difference between Conductor (conductor.build) and Orkes Conductor?

Conductor at conductor.build (by Melty Labs) is a macOS, iOS and cloud workspace app for running parallel AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. Orkes Conductor is a separate open-source microservice and workflow orchestration engine originally created at Netflix.
